provenance: observed: Landsat 8 OLI/TIRS, 28 June 2019, Glasgow city boundary
lst_method: Single-channel LST from TIRS band 10: TOA radiance -> brightness temperature -> NDVI-based emissivity (vegetation proportion) -> Sobrino correction, processed in ENVI 5.6
